change: Collect passive WPS evidence during regular Wi-Fi scan; missing evidence is not unsupported.

resources.resource_guard: Existing remote resource watchdog and bounded scan duration; not a kernel-enforced file quota.

diagnostics: Only byte/count/error-type summaries; no SSID, BSSID, raw packets or credentials in added logs.
limits: No live router or RF verification in this change.
Debian backend tests used unchanged backend modules while bypassing the Qt-dependent desktop package initializer. Debian GUI was not verified.
Passive detection requires receiving a valid WPS IE; missing or malformed evidence remains undetected.
Existing scan temporarily retains PCAP on router until owned workspace cleanup; no persistent local packet copy added.

findings_fixed: Truncated packet records could be treated as complete evidence.
Explicit classic-PCAP FCS metadata was not interpreted.
three_pass_review.evidence: Two failing regression tests first reproduced parser boundaries; all 15 WPS tests then passed.

findings_fixed: Default airodump output saved only the first beacon per AP; --beacons now preserves state updates.
SFTP servers may omit st_size, previously causing TypeError.
Metadata transfer used the 120-second default shared-lock budget.
Broken SFTP channels were retained after timeout.
three_pass_review.evidence: Three failing tests first reproduced transfer issues; all 18 WPS tests then passed.

three_pass_review.scope: Integration, remaining I/O budgets, error families, compatibility and resources
findings_fixed: Post-connect stat/open requests could exceed the remaining metadata budget.
Paramiko SFTPError is separate from SSHException and needed explicit metadata fallback and channel disposal.
verified: Metadata merge preserves selection and capture fields.
Unknown and locked targets do not launch a WPS process.
Table and export use the same status labels.
No new operating-system branches or router dependencies.
Metadata cache remains at 4096 entries after 4097 distinct APs and over 32 MiB streamed input.
three_pass_review.evidence: A failing remaining-budget test reproduced the additional delay; actual installed Paramiko exception hierarchy was checked; final Windows 103 tests and Debian 21 backend tests passed.

pass_1.scope: Independent cross-check of lock transitions against official hostap releases.
pass_1.fixed: A complete WPS IE that omits AP Setup Locked must clear the previous lock, matching hostap 2.9/2.10/2.11. Missing WPS or incomplete mandatory fields do not clear a known lock.
pass_1.evidence: Failing regression reproduced stale locked state before the fix. Previous conservative test expectation was corrected after checking the actual producer.

pass_2.scope: Cancellation races and actual Paramiko buffered-file semantics.
pass_2.fixed: Cancellation raised during stat returning zero size or FileNotFoundError was lost through early-return branches.
pass_2.evidence: A failing race test reproduced the lost cancellation. A real SFTPFile with an in-memory protocol peer verified partial-buffer timeout, exact committed-offset resume and file-handle close.

pass_3.scope: Producer/parser format match, all fixture split positions, malformed input, live Qt row updates and cross-platform regression.
evidence: Aircrack Linux input normalizes frames and strips FCS before writing classic PCAP.
All 333 split positions of the official fixture reproduced the same WPS result.
12000 deterministic malformed/mutated inputs caused no parser crash or pending-buffer/metadata-entry limit violation.
Unlock updates the existing table item, matches export and retains selection.
Windows 107 related tests passed; Debian 23 backend tests passed.

corpus_and_official_source_evidence.limits: Finite deterministic corpus, not a general proof of correctness.

limits: No live radio, router or network SFTP server was exercised.
Real Paramiko file contract used the installed Windows Paramiko implementation with an in-memory peer.
Debian GUI and full app startup are not established by backend-only tests.
Finite deterministic input corpus is not exhaustive correctness proof.

pass_1.scope: Mandatory protocol fields and lock-transition evidence.
pass_1.finding: A WPS IE with only one mandatory field plus an explicit unlocked flag could clear a known lock and claim support.
pass_1.fix: The common parser now requires both Version and WPS State before accepting the IE. Incomplete evidence cannot add support or change lock state.
pass_1.evidence: Regression failed before the change; the official wps_validate_beacon and wps_validate_beacon_probe_resp both mark these two fields mandatory.

pass_2.scope: Actual Paramiko cancellation during read combined with file-close protocol failure and repeated close.
pass_2.evidence: Both successful close and failing-close cases preserve InterruptedError, close the file only once and leave the shared SSH session intact. Broken SFTP disposal remains under the transfer lock.

pass_3.scope: Multi-AP transition ordering, randomized stream segmentation, producer format, integration and platform regression.

limits: This was an independent targeted review, not a proof of absence of all bugs.
No router/RF or real network SFTP-server verification.
Debian headless backend tests bypass the Qt desktop initializer; no Debian GUI validation.

pass_1.scope: Protocol attribute value domains and WPS 2.x compatibility.
pass_1.finding: Legacy Version attribute values were not validated; every byte value was accepted even though only 0x10 is valid in this attribute.
pass_1.fix: Use one shared allowed-value table for Version, WPS State and AP Setup Locked.
pass_1.evidence: Exhaustive 768-value test initially reproduced 255 invalid Version acceptances. After the fix all domains and the official WPS 2.0 fixture passed. Official hostap 2.9/2.10/2.11 builders explicitly emit 0x10 even in WPS 2.x.

pass_2.scope: Cancellation/resource abort during metadata read plus owned-process stop failure.
pass_2.evidence: Four combinations verify one owned PID stop, preservation of primary and stop error messages, no final CSV transfer or completion callback. Real Paramiko partial-read and close-failure tests also pass.

pass_3.scope: Classic-PCAP representation and incremental parsing across platforms.
pass_3.evidence: Big/little endian and micro/nanosecond magic values combined with raw 802.11, explicit FCS, radiotap and radiotap-with-FCS all preserve identical WPS evidence under 13-byte incremental feeds.

limits: No actual router, RF or network SFTP-server validation.
Debian backend tests bypass the Qt-dependent package initializer and exclude the two Qt table tests; actual Paramiko-file tests ran on Windows.

pass_1.scope: Independent upstream C validator execution versus production passive WPS parsing
pass_1.method: Extracted unchanged Version, WPS State and AP Setup Locked function bodies from official hostap 2.9/2.10/2.11 releases; compiled using gcc with logging, typedef and enum stubs only; compared every byte value against actual Python parse_wps_frame.

pass_2.scope: Owned scan-process cleanup, shared transfer-lock boundary, timeout/cancel propagation and actual Paramiko buffered-file closure
pass_2.evidence: Read scanner finally/transfer/drop_sftp paths and reran cancellation/resource plus stop-failure matrix and native Paramiko partial-read/close-failure tests.

pass_3.scope: Related dictionary scheduling/history/control regressions, WPS UI/export integration, Debian backend, syntax and encoding checks

limits: Offline tests only; no real router, RF or network SFTP-server validation.
Debian tests bypass Qt-dependent package initialization and exclude two Qt tests; actual Paramiko-file tests run on Windows.
C oracle checks only three WPS attributes; it does not execute a wireless service or validate a full WPS handshake.
No new confirmed defect in reviewed scope is not proof that the application is free of bugs.
